what: First real captures for tools/kernel_bandwidth.py and a host-calibration check of tools/perf_model.py. One rented RTX 3090 on Vast.ai, one session, 2026-11-09. The CSVs next to this file are `nsys stats --report cuda_gpu_kern_sum --format csv` from scripts/sweeps/decode-step-profile.sh.
model: qwen3_8_27b.ninfer (Qwen3.8-27B groupwise-int, the 3090 recipe), int8 KV, max context 8192, tg128 from a one-token seed on the bundled corpus

host.os: Linux, container, Ubuntu 24.04 / CUDA 12.8.1 base image

under_load.clocks_event_reason: SW Power Cap active; no thermal or HW slowdown

host.note: The host caps this card at 220 W, so under decode load the SM clock sits near 700 MHz, a third of its maximum. Absolute numbers here are NOT comparable to a 315-350 W card; ratios and structure are.
